import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxN = 70;
    static final int maxn = 50;
    static final int lim = 22;

    static long[][] binom = new long[maxN + 5][maxN + 5];

    static void precompute_binom() {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxN; ++i) {
            binom[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                binom[i][j] = binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    static int n, m, N, mid;
    static int[] g = new int[maxN + 5];
    static ArrayList<Pair>[][] partb = new ArrayList[maxN + 5][maxN + 5];
    static HashMap<Long, Long>[][] parta = new HashMap[maxN + 5][maxN + 5];
    static long ans = Long.MAX_VALUE, ans_cnt = 0;

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long first;
        int second;
        Pair(long f, int s) { first = f; second = s; }
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            if (first < o.first) return -1;
            if (first > o.first) return 1;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    static void dfs_partb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, long sum) {
        if (x == mid) {
            partb[cnta][cntb].add(new Pair(sum, 1));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
            if (g[x - 1] != -1 && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
            long tmp = 0;
            if (i == 0) {
                if (cnta > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                        tmp += binom[cnta - 1][n - 1] * binom[cntb][j] * binom[N - x][n - j];
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp);
                }
            } else {
                if (cntb > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                        tmp -= binom[cntb - 1][n - 1] * binom[cnta][j] * binom[N - x][n - j];
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void update(long val, long cnt) {
        if (val < ans) { ans = val; ans_cnt = cnt; }
        else if (val == ans) ans_cnt += cnt;
    }

    static void bfs_parta() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j)
                parta[i][j].clear();
        parta[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j) {
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> u : parta[i][j].entrySet()) {
                    if (i + j == mid) {
                        int p = Collections.binarySearch(partb[i][j], new Pair(-u.getKey(), -1));
                        if (p < 0) p = -p - 1;
                        if (p < partb[i][j].size())
                            update(Math.abs(u.getKey() + partb[i][j].get(p).first), u.getValue() * partb[i][j].get(p).second);
                        if (p > 0) {
                            update(Math.abs(u.getKey() + partb[i][j].get(p - 1).first), u.getValue() * partb[i][j].get(p - 1).second);
                        }
                    } else {
                        int p = i + j;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
                            if (g[p] != -1 && k != g[p]) continue;
                            int cnta = i, cntb = j;
                            if (k == 0) ++cnta;
                            else ++cntb;
                            if (cnta <= n + m && cntb <= n + m) {
                                long tmp = 0;
                                if (k == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l)
                                        tmp += binom[cnta - 1][n - 1] * binom[cntb][l] * binom[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l)
                                        tmp -= binom[cntb - 1][n - 1] * binom[cnta][l] * binom[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                }
                                parta[cnta][cntb].merge(u.getKey() + tmp, u.getValue(), Long::sum);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void work() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j)
                partb[i][j].clear();
        dfs_partb(N, n + m, n + m, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j) {
                Collections.sort(partb[i][j]);
                ArrayList<Pair> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
                int sz = partb[i][j].size();
                for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                    long cur = partb[i][j].get(k).first;
                    int cnt = 0;
                    while (k < sz && partb[i][j].get(k).first == cur) {
                        cnt += partb[i][j].get(k).second;
                        ++k;
                    }
                    tmp.add(new Pair(cur, cnt));
                }
                partb[i][j] = tmp;
            }
        }
        bfs_parta();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        precompute_binom();
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        String s = sc.next();
        N = (n + m) << 1;
        mid = Math.max(0, N - lim);
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        // Initialize partb and parta arrays
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= maxN; ++j) {
                partb[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                parta[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        work();
        ans_cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (c == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }
        work();
        System.out.println(ans_cnt);
    }
}
